subQuestions.label: b
subQuestions.text: The boy and girl is playing in the park.

subQuestions.label: c
subQuestions.text: She have two brothers and one sister.

questions.text:
Identify the parts of speech:

The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

The: ________ | quick: ________ | fox: ________

Rewrite using reported speech:

Direct: He said, "I am a doctor."
Indirect: ________

Write a short paragraph on "My Best Friend":

Write 5-7 sentences about your best friend.
Include: name, appearance, qualities, why they are your friend.

mappedAnswers.aiFeedback: Spot on! You correctly identified the simple present form to describe a daily routine.
Wonderful job using the past continuous tense to show an action in progress! Your grammar choice is perfect.
Excellent! You correctly used the simple past tense for a completed past action.
Great work fixing the subject-verb agreement! Using "doesn't" for a third-person singular subject is completely correct.

mappedAnswers.questionText: The boy and girl is playing in the park.
mappedAnswers.answerText: The boy and girl are playing in the park.
mappedAnswers.aiFeedback: Fantastic correction! You correctly recognized that a compound subject requires the plural verb "are."

mappedAnswers.questionText: She have two brothers and one sister.
mappedAnswers.answerText: She has two brothers and one sister.
mappedAnswers.aiFeedback: Perfect! Changing "have" to "has" shows a great understanding of singular subject agreement.

mappedAnswers.questionText:
Identify the parts of speech:

The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

The: ________ | quick: ________ | fox: ________
mappedAnswers.answerText: The: Article | quick: Adjective | Fox: Noun
mappedAnswers.aiFeedback: Impressive work! You accurately labeled the article, adjective, and noun in the sentence.

mappedAnswers.questionText:
Rewrite using reported speech:

Direct: He said, "I am a doctor."
Indirect: ________
mappedAnswers.answerText: He said that he was a doctor.
mappedAnswers.aiFeedback: Brilliant reported speech conversion! You handled the tense shift from "am" to "was" flawlessly.

mappedAnswers.questionText:
Write a short paragraph on "My Best Friend":

Write 5-7 sentences about your best friend.
Include: name, appearance, qualities, why they are your friend.
mappedAnswers.answerText: My best friend is Priya. She is tall and has long black hair. She is very kind and helpful. She always helps me in my studies. We play together after school. I love her company very much. She is the best friend anyone can have.
mappedAnswers.aiFeedback: What a lovely paragraph about Priya! You included all the required details about her appearance and qualities with great sentence variety.
